title: Mylo's Crystal Run
description: A retro side-scrolling platformer where space prospector Mylo runs through alien crystal caverns, shooting and stomping enemies while collecting gems to reach the exit.
prompt:
Create a single-file HTML5 side-scrolling platformer game called 'Mylo's Crystal Run' inspired by classic 1990s Apogee DOS games Crystal Caves and Commander Keen.

GAMEPLAY: You control Mylo, a space prospector running through alien crystal caverns. The goal is to reach the exit door at the end of each level while collecting as many crystals and gems as possible. Levels are side-scrolling caves with platforms, ledges, and bottomless pits.

CONTROLS: Arrow keys to move left/right, Space to jump, Z to shoot your laser pistol. You can also stomp on enemies by jumping on them (like Commander Keen's pogo bounce — you bounce up after landing on an enemy).

ENEMIES: Crawling cave bugs, floating crystal drones, and bouncing slime creatures. Some shoot at you, others just patrol. Enemies can be shot or stomped.

COLLECTIBLES: Small blue crystals (10 pts), large green gems (50 pts), red power gems that restore 1 health, gold keys to open locked doors. There's also ammo pickups for your laser pistol.

HEALTH & LIVES: You have 3 hearts of health. Lose all health or fall into a pit and you lose a life. Game over at 0 lives. Collecting 100 crystals awards an extra life.

DIFFICULTY RAMP: Each level adds more platforms, tougher enemy patterns, wider pits, and moving platforms. Level 1 is easy introduction, level 2 adds flying enemies, level 3 has moving platforms and shooters.

VISUAL STYLE: Retro pixel art in the style of EGA/VGA DOS games (bright colors, chunky pixels on a dark background). The character sprites should look like they came from a 1991 Apogee game — cute, cartoonish, with exaggerated expressions. Scrolling background with stalactites and cavern walls. Use a pixelated font for the HUD showing score, lives, health, crystals, and ammo.

SOUND: Simple retro beeps and boops for jumping, shooting, collecting items, and dying. A chiptune-style background music loop.

TECH: Single self-contained HTML file. Use Canvas 2D for rendering and the Web Audio API for sound generation (no external assets). Keyboard controls only. Responsive canvas centered on screen. Show a title screen with 'Press SPACE to Start', a game-over screen with final score and 'Press SPACE to Restart', and a victory screen when all 3 levels are completed.
